newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's first gold output, in '97, to be 900 kgs.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's first gold output, in '97, to be 900 kgs.

text.p: Ukraine's first gold production, planned for 1997, will total 900 kilograms, the official Ukrinform news agency said on Wednesday.
It said Industry Minister Valery Mazur had made the forecast at a parliamentary committee meeting.
"The potential for gold finds in Ukraine is quite high but little-documented," parliament's Geology Committee head, Mykola Havrylenko, was quoted as saying.
The former Soviet republic has not yet mined gold, but hopes to produce 12-15 tonnes a year in three to four years.
It has identified five gold deposits and three are under exploration, mostly in the Trans-Carpathian region. --Irene Marushko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
